title: Add pgvector search

context.summary: Replace the pgvector placeholder with a PostgreSQL-backed vector index for document chunk embeddings and semantic document search.
context.background: TASK-19 registers embed/index processors but leaves vector runtime optional. TASK-20 adds the default pgvector MVP path required by the PRD.

in: Add pgvector extension/table/index schema and migration SQL.
Implement PgVectorChunkIndex upsert, delete and cosine search.
Add HTTP document search support through embeddings plus pgvector when embeddings are configured.
Wire worker indexing to PgVectorChunkIndex when embeddings are enabled.
Keep Qdrant as an optional future adapter.
Update docs and validation scripts for pgvector runtime behavior.
out: Tune per-model vector dimensions beyond the MVP default.
Add live migration execution or Docker runtime commands.
Implement memory derivation or session summaries.

acceptance_criteria: Database schema and initial migration create the pgvector extension and chunk_vector_embeddings table.
@mindory/vector-pgvector implements upsert, delete and search without vector_index_not_implemented placeholders.
Worker runtime injects PgVectorChunkIndex when embeddings are configured.
API document/context search uses pgvector-backed search when embeddings are configured and falls back to text search when embeddings are disabled.
Docs and validations describe pgvector as the default MVP vector runtime.

manual_checks: Confirm pgvector search still requires embeddings provider configuration.
Confirm no jobs API routes were added.

risks: The MVP schema uses vector(1536) as the default pgvector dimension, so deployments must configure an embedding model with matching dimensions or change the migration deliberately.
pgvector behavior is typechecked and structurally validated but not exercised against a live PostgreSQL database in this task.
API semantic search calls an embeddings provider at query time when embeddings are enabled.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
